jd_insights.summary: Meta seeks entry-level software engineers to join its Bangalore team, focusing on building and improving products that connect billions globally. The role involves solving complex technical challenges, writing high-quality code, and contributing to platforms like mobile and web applications while adhering to Meta’s development standards. Engineers will grow through mentorship, feedback, and increasingly complex projects, directly impacting how people connect worldwide.

knowledge_requirements.text: understanding of relevant product area, codebase, and/or systems
proficient in data analysis, programming and software engineering
master Meta’s development standards from developing to releasing code
familiarity with modern abstractions and frameworks

knowledge_mentions.excerpt: designed scalable microservices architectures with **concurrency control** (e.g., order matching system using redis for cache)
optimized ml inference services for production, including **model batching and throughput tuning**
implemented **oauth2/jwt authentication** and **role-based authorization** in spring boot/react applications
developed **real-time data pipelines** (airflow, kafka-like systems) with fault tolerance and parallel processing
applied **code-splitting and lazy loading** in react to improve ux response times
debugged and optimized **sql queries and etl jobs** for performance-critical workflows
deployed containerized applications (docker/kubernetes) on aws with **auto-scaling and monitoring**
